definitions.full: H6920. qaddachath צ֫וֺעַר צֹ֫עַר, proper name, of a location Zoar (understood as insignficance , compare Gen 19:20 ); — Σηλωρ , ᵐ5 L Σιλωρ , but 13:10 ; Jer 48:34 Ζογορ ( α ); on ᵐ5 compare further Lag BN 54 f. : city at southeast end of Dead Sea, צֹעַר Gen 13:10 ; 14:2 , 8 (both = בֶּלַע ) Deut 34:3 ; Isa 15:5 ; Jer 48:34 ; צוֺעַר Gen 19:22 , 30 (twice in verse); with ה locative, צֹ֫עֲרָה 19:23 + Jer 48:4 (for צעוריה ᵑ0 ), ᵐ5 Ζαλορα , JDMich Ew Gf Gie and others — (compare Buhl Geogr. 271. 274 GASm Geogr.506 f. 678 (App.) . קַדַּ֫חַת noun feminine fever ; — Deut 28:22 ; Lev 26:16 .
